capabilities: , Organize content in columns or masonry walls.
Insert tasks, lists, and formatted text.
Manage and attach files and images.
Reorder and move cards between columns.
extras: Attachments are limited to 25 MB each and 20 per import. Touch behavior has not been verified on physical iOS or Android devices.
problem: Users need a visual way to organize notes, tasks, and attachments into structured columns or dynamic walls within Obsidian.
summary: Kanban board plugin that organizes Markdown notes, images, and files into customizable columns or a responsive masonry wall.
